title: Scientists discover a hidden oxygen reservoir deep inside Earth
caption:
Deep inside our mantle, magma can store up to five percent extra oxygen under immense pressure. As ancient molten rock ascended billions of years ago, it may have released enough gas to build our breathable sky.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a hidden oxygen reservoir deep inside Earth

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261027063702.htm
